stages.name: Intake
stages.sub: free text → RetrievalRequest · no model call
does: Takes a construct, a role and any concrete instances
Never renders the role; leaves population unset by contract
Renders one deterministic query string: no paraphrase, no sampling, no model
stages.placeholder: Will show the real RetrievalRequest and the string the shipped template rendered for it.

stages.name: Retriever
stages.sub: fine-tuned bge-small · argmax cosine over precomputed target vectors · fp32 CPU
does: Encodes the rendered query on CPU
Scores against every precomputed target vector: no model call, no network
Abstains when the top cosine falls below the shipped threshold
Refuses to serve at all if the dictionary hash does not match
stages.placeholder: Will show a real run: cosine, rank, margin, threshold, abstention and roster fold size, with the target pseudonymised.

stages.name: Funnel
stages.sub: S1 enumerate · S2 prune · S3 estimability · S4 literature density
does: S1 enumerates candidate exposure–outcome pairs over distinct constructs
S2 prunes on construct identity, battery membership, free text
S3 screens estimability: blocked until two survey metadata exports arrive
S4 tags literature density; a tag, never a prune
stages.placeholder: Will show the gate's real output: how many pairs were live, passed and blocked, and which exports are missing.

stages.name: Specifier
stages.sub: adjudicate → reason → gate → transduce → authority → validate → rank
does: adjudicate() runs before the first call and returns the same answer for every sample
The reasoning call has tools and loops until it stops calling or hits the step limit
_gate() checks the required calls are in the log, not that the prose claims them
tool_authority overwrites every environment-computed field and drops stale rationales
_rank() is a pure function of the record: no judge, no self-rating
stages.placeholder: Will show a real reasoning-loop tool log. Waits for the pipeline loop.
stages.waits_for: the pipeline loop's item 11 (specifier emits the record), then a tier-A redaction of its keys

stages.name: Record
does: Carries the full retrieval record for every variable, never a bare key
Stamps estimability, so an unverifiable design cannot read as a verified one
Holds the causal structure as a typed DAG; a mediator under a cross-sectional design fails validation
Reserves an empty critique seam, so adding a reviewer later needs no schema change
stages.placeholder: Will show a real HypothesisRecord. Waits for the pipeline loop.
stages.waits_for: the pipeline loop's item 13 (output artefact schema), then a tier-A redaction of its keys

stages.name: Score
stages.sub: match rate vs held-out published findings · contamination verdicts
does: Scores committed artefacts against a key held on a branch the pipeline never sees
Refuses to score anything generated where the key was reachable
Reports match rate only beside contamination and leakage verdicts
Runs exactly once, on a tag, before any tuning, so it cannot become a feedback signal
